item.title: About Me
item.description:
I am a person who is passionate learning about Cloud Computing or DevOps, with more than 2 years of experience in Cloud Computing and Systems. I have a strong foundation in Linux, Virtualization, and Containerization technologies.

I am a continuous learner with a passion for exploring and implementing the latest advancements in Cloud Computing and DevOps methodologies.

I am eager to contribute my skills and expertise to a challenging and dynamic environment, where I can collaborate with teams and contribute to innovative projects. Let’s build something amazing together! 😊
